governance: structure fluid, identity frozen — ids never change; structural change = semver bump

nodes.label: Politics, Governance & Law
nodes.definition: Moments centered on political power, statehood, governance institutions, diplomacy, and legal/judicial order rather than culture, economics, or warfare per se.

nodes.label: Rulership & Succession
nodes.definition: Transfers and terminations of sovereign authority — how rulers take, give up, or lose the throne.

nodes.label: Accession & Coronation
nodes.definition: A monarch, emperor, or ruler formally assumes power via accession, crowning, or proclamation.

nodes.label: Royal Death & Succession
nodes.definition: The death (natural, poisoning, or otherwise) of a sovereign and the resulting succession question.

nodes.label: Abdication & Deposition
nodes.definition: A ruler voluntarily abdicates or is forced to renounce the throne.

nodes.label: Dynastic Birth
nodes.definition: Birth of a royal/dynastic heir with succession weight.

nodes.label: Refusal / Declining of Office
nodes.definition: Declining or refusing an offered crown or office (inverse of accession).

nodes.label: Political Violence & Upheaval
nodes.definition: Violent contests over power — assassinations, coups, revolts, and revolutions that seize or resist authority.

nodes.label: Assassination
nodes.definition: The targeted killing of a political leader or figure to alter the balance of power.

nodes.label: Coup & Usurpation
nodes.definition: An extralegal seizure or overthrow of government by a faction, army, or claimant.

nodes.label: Revolt, Uprising & Revolution
nodes.definition: Popular or provincial armed resistance against ruling authority, from local revolts to national revolutions.

nodes.label: Diplomacy & Treaties
nodes.definition: Negotiated relations between states — treaties, peace accords, alliances, and diplomatic settlements.

nodes.label: Treaty, Alliance & Peace Accord
nodes.definition: The signing of a treaty, alliance, armistice, or peace settlement between polities.

nodes.label: Conquest & State Formation
nodes.definition: Changes in the map of sovereignty — conquest, annexation, and occupation on one side; independence and the founding of new states on the other.

nodes.label: Conquest, Annexation & Occupation
nodes.definition: One polity absorbs, invades, or occupies another’s territory, extinguishing or subordinating its sovereignty.

nodes.label: Independence & State Founding
nodes.definition: A new state, republic, empire, or province comes into being through independence, unification, or formal establishment.

nodes.label: Law & Justice
nodes.definition: The making of law and the administration of justice — legislation, constitutions, trials, and punishment.

nodes.label: Legislation, Edicts & Decrees
nodes.definition: The enactment of a law, act, edict, decree, or royal assent that changes the legal order.

nodes.label: Constitutions & Charters
nodes.definition: The granting or adoption of a foundational legal instrument — constitution, charter, or bill of rights.

nodes.label: Trials & Political Punishment
nodes.definition: Judicial or extrajudicial proceedings and their penalties — trials, tribunals, proscriptions, executions, and exile of political figures.

nodes.label: Governance & Popular Politics
nodes.definition: The routine institutional and mass-participatory side of politics — selecting leaders, forming governments, and popular political action in the streets.

nodes.label: Elections & Official Selection
nodes.definition: The selection of a leader or body through election, referendum, plebiscite, or conclave.

nodes.label: Appointments & Government Formation
nodes.definition: The appointment of officials (governors, regents, co-rulers, ministers) or the formation of a government, party, or council.

nodes.label: Protest, Riot & Civil Unrest
nodes.definition: Mass political action outside formal institutions — protests, riots, strikes, and politically charged massacres.

nodes.label: Deliberative Assembly & Congress
nodes.definition: Convening of a parliament, diet, estates, or transnational congress.

nodes.label: Legislature Dissolution
nodes.definition: Forced or formal dissolution/disbanding of a legislative body.

nodes.label: Conflict & Warfare
nodes.definition: Organized armed violence as such — pitched battles, sieges and sacks, and massacres — canonicalizing military moments that recur across the political, economic, and religious lenses.

nodes.label: Battles & Sieges
nodes.definition: Military engagements: field battles and the investment, storming, and sacking of fortified places.

nodes.label: Pitched Battle
nodes.definition: A set-piece armed engagement between opposing forces in the field.

nodes.label: Siege & Sack
nodes.definition: The blockade, storming, capture, or sacking of a fortified city or stronghold.

nodes.label: Massacre & Atrocity
nodes.definition: The mass killing of combatants or civilians outside pitched battle — massacres, sackings’ slaughter, and reprisals.

nodes.label: War Declaration & Outbreak
nodes.definition: Formal declaration of war or the outbreak/onset of an armed conflict.

nodes.label: Economy, Trade & Labor
nodes.definition: Moments centered on economic life: work and labor conflict, commerce and enterprise, money and finance, trade policy, commercialization of goods, and trade infrastructure.

nodes.label: Labor Movements & Worker Conflict
nodes.definition: Collective action by industrial workers and the reforms that resulted: strikes, lockouts, union organizing, and labor legislation.

nodes.label: Strike & Lockout
nodes.definition: Work stoppages, walkouts, employer lockouts, and worker uprisings over wages and working conditions.

nodes.label: Labor Reform & Accord
nodes.definition: Negotiated settlements, labor laws, and international labor institutions that codified worker rights.

nodes.label: Agrarian & Feudal Revolt
nodes.definition: Peasant uprisings against feudal economic burdens, dominated in this corpus by the German Peasants’ War of 1524-25.

nodes.label: Peasant Demands & Assembly
nodes.definition: Drafting and proclamation of peasant grievances (the Twelve Articles) and the parliaments and assemblies that voiced them.

nodes.label: Revolt Battle & Suppression
nodes.definition: Battles, massacres, captures, and executions through which authorities crushed the peasant revolt.

nodes.label: Enterprise & Commerce
nodes.definition: The chartering, founding, and milestones of commercial organizations, from royal-chartered trading companies and guilds to modern corporations.

nodes.label: Chartered Company & Guild
nodes.definition: Royal charters establishing trading companies, guilds, and licensed monopolies in the early-modern commercial order.

nodes.label: Corporate Founding & Milestone
nodes.definition: The incorporation, founding, and acquisition of modern companies as business (not scientific) events.

nodes.label: Money & Finance
nodes.definition: Banking institutions, exchanges, public offerings, currency introductions, and monetary reforms.

nodes.label: Banking & Exchange
nodes.definition: Founding of banks and exchanges, financier milestones, and equity-market events such as public offerings.

nodes.label: Currency & Monetary Reform
nodes.definition: Introduction of new currencies and monetary stabilization measures, often responding to inflation or reparations crises.

nodes.label: Trade Policy & Economic Governance
nodes.definition: State and multilateral economic action: tariffs, trade agreements, customs unions, reparations, and international economic summits.

nodes.label: Tariff & Trade Dispute
nodes.definition: Imposition of tariffs, withdrawal from trade pacts, customs unions, and other bilateral trade conflicts.

nodes.label: Economic Summit & Reparations
nodes.definition: Multilateral economic summits (G20) and coercive economic enforcement such as war reparations and industrial occupation.

nodes.label: Commercial Product Launch
nodes.definition: Market entry and commercialization of goods and technologies: consumer product launches and the debut of foundational commercial hardware.

nodes.label: Consumer Product Launch
nodes.definition: Public unveilings and market releases of consumer goods and services (phones, smart speakers, apps, radios).

nodes.label: Foundational Computing Hardware
nodes.definition: Commercialization and first delivery of foundational computing hardware: integrated circuits, early commercial computers, and mainframes.

nodes.label: Trade & Transport Infrastructure
nodes.definition: Openings of railways and transport lines that expanded commerce and the movement of goods and labor.

nodes.label: Culture, Religion, Arts & Ideas
nodes.definition: Moments centered on belief, worship, cultural production, learning, publishing, and the advance of human knowledge and ideas, as distinct from politics, war, or economics.

nodes.label: Religious Life & Institutions
nodes.definition: Events belonging to the governance, doctrine, ritual, conflict, and physical fabric of organized religion.

nodes.label: Church Governance & Office
nodes.definition: Institutional acts of religious authority: papal elections and coronations, councils, synods, edicts, bulls, excommunications, schisms, and the founding of orders.

nodes.label: Reform, Doctrine & Scripture
nodes.definition: Founding statements of faith and doctrine: reformist theses and confessions, prophetic revelation, conversions, and scripture translation or promulgation.

nodes.label: Religious Conflict & Martyrdom
nodes.definition: Violence and persecution driven by faith: crusades, heresy trials, martyrdoms, iconoclasm, witch trials, and confessional uprisings.

nodes.label: Ritual, Consecration & Pilgrimage
nodes.definition: Sacred observances and rites: temple and church dedications, consecrations, canonizations, feasts, jubilees, and pilgrimages.

nodes.label: Sacred Architecture
nodes.definition: The building, founding, and inauguration of religious structures — temples, cathedrals, basilicas, mosques, and shrines.

nodes.label: Letters, Print & Media
nodes.definition: The creation and dissemination of texts and broadcast content: authored works, the print revolution, and screen/broadcast media.

nodes.label: Literary & Scholarly Works
nodes.definition: The composition or publication of books, treatises, pamphlets, poems, and other authored works.

nodes.label: Printing & Publishing
nodes.definition: Milestones of the printing trade itself: first printed books, printing technology, and the regulation of the press.

nodes.label: Broadcast & Screen Media
nodes.definition: Radio, television, and film moments — service launches, notable broadcasts, and landmark programs.

nodes.label: Knowledge & Learning Institutions
nodes.definition: The advance and housing of secular knowledge: invention and technological breakthroughs, and the founding of universities and learned societies.

nodes.label: Universities & Learned Societies
nodes.definition: The founding of universities, academies, libraries, and scholarly societies.

nodes.label: Games & Sport
nodes.definition: Organized play as public event: Olympiads, tournaments, matches, and sporting firsts.

nodes.label: Disaster, Disease & Environment
nodes.definition: Natural hazards, epidemics, and subsistence crises striking a place or population.

nodes.label: Natural Disaster
nodes.definition: Sudden geophysical or weather hazard events.

nodes.label: Earthquake & Seismic Event
nodes.definition: Earthquakes and seismic destruction of a settlement.

nodes.label: Flood, Storm & Fire
nodes.definition: Floods, great storms, and urban conflagrations.

nodes.label: Volcanic & Geological Event
nodes.definition: Volcanic eruptions and other geological catastrophes.

nodes.label: Disease & Subsistence Crisis
nodes.definition: Epidemics and food-supply collapses.

nodes.label: Epidemic & Plague
nodes.definition: Outbreaks of contagious disease.

nodes.label: Famine & Subsistence Crisis
nodes.definition: Famines and mass food shortages.

nodes.label: Science, Technology & Exploration
nodes.definition: The advance of knowledge and reach: discovery, invention, engineering, voyages of exploration, and the push past Earth.

nodes.label: Invention & Technology
nodes.definition: Breakthroughs in technology and applied science: inventions, patents, engineering firsts, and computing milestones.

nodes.label: Scientific Discovery
nodes.definition: A finding about how the world works — experiments, observations, theories confirmed, prizes recognizing them.

nodes.label: Exploration & Voyage
nodes.definition: Expeditions into the unmapped: voyages of discovery, circumnavigations, polar and deep journeys.

nodes.label: Spaceflight & Frontier
nodes.definition: Leaving Earth: launches, orbits, landings, stations, and off-world firsts.

nodes.label: Bonding & Kinship
nodes.definition: Forming, tending, and repairing human ties — the relational core of a life.

nodes.label: Courtship & Falling in Love
nodes.definition: Attraction, courtship, and the forming of romantic bonds.

nodes.label: Greeting & Hospitality
nodes.definition: Meeting, welcoming, and honoring others — handshakes, introductions, receiving guests.

nodes.label: Marriage & Union
nodes.definition: Betrothal, weddings, and the formal joining of partners or families.

nodes.label: Friendship & Companionship
nodes.definition: Making friends, keeping company, loyalty and everyday togetherness.

nodes.label: Intimacy & Sex
nodes.definition: Physical and emotional intimacy between people.

nodes.label: Caregiving & Nurture
nodes.definition: Raising, feeding, tending, and protecting kin and dependents.

nodes.label: Parting & Reunion
nodes.definition: Farewells, separations, and coming back together.

nodes.label: Reconciliation & Forgiveness
nodes.definition: Repairing broken ties — apology, forgiveness, making peace between persons.

nodes.label: Life Passages & the Body
nodes.definition: The biological and existential arc of a body through time, and its daily maintenance.

nodes.label: Birth & Begetting
nodes.definition: Conceiving, gestating, and giving birth.

nodes.label: Coming of Age
nodes.definition: Growing up, initiation, and the passage into adult roles.

nodes.label: Aging & Eldership
nodes.definition: Growing old, retirement, and the roles of elders.

nodes.label: Death & Dying
nodes.definition: Dying and the personal experience of mortality.

nodes.label: Mourning & Grief
nodes.definition: Grieving, funerary care, and remembrance of the dead.

nodes.label: Health, Illness & Healing
nodes.definition: Falling ill, seeking care, healing, and tending the body’s health.

nodes.label: Eating & Drinking
nodes.definition: Nourishing the body — meals, feasts, and shared food and drink.

nodes.label: Rest & Sleep
nodes.definition: Sleeping, resting, and daily bodily recovery.

nodes.label: Grooming & Adornment
nodes.definition: Washing, dressing, adorning, and presenting the body.

nodes.label: Movement & Dwelling
nodes.definition: Moving through space and making places to be — travel that the events graph almost never records.

nodes.label: Journey & Travel
nodes.definition: Setting out and traveling from place to place, for its own sake or purpose.

nodes.label: Migration & Resettlement
nodes.definition: Relocating a life — emigration, displacement, and settling somewhere new.

nodes.label: Exploration & Wayfinding
nodes.definition: Venturing into the unknown, navigating, and finding the way.

nodes.label: Everyday Movement & Commute
nodes.definition: Routine getting-about — walking, riding, commuting, errands.
nodes.deprecation_note: Folded into its sibling: the routine-vs-notable split of movement produced 3 classifications ever (0 real) and no bridge or lateral edge referenced it. journey-and-travel covers setting out and traveling from place to place; routine getting-about is that, at smaller scale.

nodes.label: Homemaking & Dwelling
nodes.definition: Making, keeping, and inhabiting a home.

nodes.label: Making & Cultivating
nodes.definition: Bringing things into being and tending living things — craft, construction, cultivation, and creative work.

nodes.label: Art-Making & Craft
nodes.definition: Making art and objects — painting, sculpting, weaving, and the crafts.

nodes.label: Building & Construction
nodes.definition: Constructing dwellings, structures, and works with the hands.

nodes.label: Cooking & Foodways
nodes.definition: Preparing food and drink and the practices around it.

nodes.label: Cultivating & Tending
nodes.definition: Gardening, husbandry, and tending plants and animals as living craft.

nodes.label: Invention & Tinkering
nodes.definition: Designing, tinkering, and devising new tools and techniques.

nodes.label: Music & Performance
nodes.definition: Making music, dancing, acting, and performing for others.

nodes.label: Writing & Composition
nodes.definition: Composing text — writing, poetry, correspondence, and authorship.

nodes.label: Knowing & Meaning
nodes.definition: The inner work of understanding, deciding, and making sense of things.

nodes.label: Learning & Study
nodes.definition: Acquiring skill and knowledge through study and practice.

nodes.label: Teaching & Mentoring
nodes.definition: Instructing, guiding, and passing knowledge to others.

nodes.label: Inquiry & Discovery
nodes.definition: Investigating, experimenting, and coming to understand something new.

nodes.label: Contemplation & Prayer
nodes.definition: Reflecting, meditating, and praying — the interior search for meaning.

nodes.label: Remembering & Recording
nodes.definition: Recalling, commemorating, and keeping records of experience.

nodes.label: Deciding & Judging
nodes.definition: Weighing options, choosing, and forming judgments.

nodes.label: Believing & Conversion
nodes.definition: Coming to belief, changing one’s mind, and personal conversion.

nodes.label: Communication & Exchange
nodes.definition: Passing meaning and value between people — talk, expression, and the trading of things.

nodes.label: Conversation & Storytelling
nodes.definition: Talking, listening, gossip, and telling stories.

nodes.label: Expression & Display
nodes.definition: Showing feeling, style, or identity — self-expression and display.

nodes.label: Persuasion & Rhetoric
nodes.definition: Convincing, appealing, arguing a case, and moving others to act.

nodes.label: Trade & Barter
nodes.definition: Buying, selling, bartering, and everyday economic exchange between persons.

nodes.label: Gift & Reciprocity
nodes.definition: Giving, receiving, and returning gifts and favors.

nodes.label: Negotiation & Agreement
nodes.definition: Bargaining, promising, and reaching agreement between parties.

nodes.label: Play, Rite & Celebration
nodes.definition: Non-instrumental action done for its own sake or for the sacred — play, festivity, and rite.

nodes.label: Play & Games
nodes.definition: Playing, gaming, and improvised fun.

nodes.label: Sport & Contest
nodes.definition: Athletic play and rule-bound physical contest.

nodes.label: Festivity & Celebration
nodes.definition: Feasts, holidays, parties, and marking joyful occasions.

nodes.label: Ritual & Ceremony
nodes.definition: Enacting rites and ceremonies that mark meaning and passage.

nodes.label: Worship & Devotion
nodes.definition: Personal and communal worship, devotion, and observance.

nodes.label: Humor & Mirth
nodes.definition: Joking, laughing, and shared amusement.

nodes.label: Leisure & Recreation
nodes.definition: Relaxing, hobbies, and unstructured free time.

nodes.label: Work & Provision
nodes.definition: Instrumental effort to sustain oneself and others — labor, subsistence, and mutual help.

nodes.label: Labor & Toil
nodes.definition: Working, laboring, and the daily effort of a trade or task.

nodes.label: Subsistence & Foraging
nodes.definition: Hunting, gathering, fishing, and drawing a living from the land.

nodes.label: Service & Assistance
nodes.definition: Serving, helping, and doing for others.

nodes.label: Cooperation & Collective Effort
nodes.definition: Working together — teamwork, mutual aid, and joint undertakings.

nodes.label: Stewardship & Provision
nodes.definition: Providing for, managing, and safeguarding resources and dependents.

nodes.label: Striving & Harm
nodes.definition: Contest and injury at the human scale — rivalry, deceit, and violence that the events graph only sees once it becomes a battle.

nodes.label: Competition & Rivalry
nodes.definition: Competing, rivalry, and striving to win or outdo.

nodes.label: Argument & Quarrel
nodes.definition: Disputing, quarreling, and interpersonal conflict in words.

nodes.label: Deception & Manipulation
nodes.definition: Lying, cheating, betraying, and manipulating others.

nodes.label: Aggression & Violence
nodes.definition: Fighting, assault, and interpersonal violence.

nodes.label: Defense & Protection
nodes.definition: Defending, guarding, and protecting self and others from harm.

nodes.label: Punishment & Retribution
nodes.definition: Punishing, avenging, and exacting retribution at the personal scale.

nodes.label: Dominance & Submission
nodes.definition: Asserting authority and yielding to it — commanding, obeying, submitting.

bridges.note: a battle is fighting, at scale
a treaty is a handshake, at scale
campaigning and oratory are the action inside an election
judgment is the action inside a trial
command and obedience are the micro-fabric of rulership
royalty only; everyone else’s birth is invisible to Lens A
feasts and jubilees appear only when sacred or royal
History records eating only when it fails
illness enters the record only at population scale
no event node exists for ordinary migration
travel is nearly invisible to the events graph
the private core of a life leaves no public event
bridged in v1.1 — sport leaves the kernel; Olympiads now have a home

design_principles: a missing bridge is a finding, not a gap
